mapper.insert: INSERT INTO option_group (option_group_id, name, description, created_at) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{optionGroupId}), #{name}, #{description}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), description = VALUES(description)
INSERT INTO option_item (option_group_id, position, name, description, price, created_at) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{optionGroupId}), #{position}, #{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM option_item WHERE option_group_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{optionGroupId})
mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(option_group_id) AS option_group_id, name, description, created_at FROM option_group WHERE option_group_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{optionGroupId})
SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(option_group_id) AS option_group_id, position, name, description, price, created_at FROM option_item WHERE option_group_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{optionGroupId}) ORDER BY position ASC
